args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting your front door. Sorry, our system wrongly logged it as a fridge issue; we've corrected it and are treating it as an urgent door repair. Please ignore the fridge questions. A few quick ones: 1) Does the door close and lock securely once slammed? 2) Is any glass in or beside the door cracked or loose? 3) Is the back door the same? 4) Any entry codes/alarms, pets, and best times for access? For now, please avoid slamming the door hard, and keep clear of any cracked glass. If you can't secure the door, tell us straight away. We're asking your landlord to approve the repair and you'll hear from us by 2024-06-07.
